id./param/scenario/cs/b_040_cs_100.pack|cs_: "Hi-i, everyone! Listen up!
"...I'm quitting the parade!
"What!? Nooo!
"But don't worry! Only until I beat Mordegon! Then I'll come straight back to you!
"...We'll cheer you on! We can't forgive Mordegon for stealing everyone's smiles!
"I'll cheer too!
"It's sad that you're leaving, but only you can beat Mordegon!
"Yes, to bring smiles back to the world! Until then, I want you to wait in Puerto Valor, where my papi lives!
"...Papi? ...Puerto Valor?
"Y-You... Surely not, but... are you Norberto?
"Hee hee, you finally noticed! I've waited ages for you to realize... Hen-drik!
"So, off to Puerto Valor!
"H-How could this be... Serious Norberto, like that... Don Rodrigo will be furious.
"Oh, {var:1}. S-Sorry. It was such a shock that I lost my composure.
"...His real name is Norberto, heir of a noble knightly house of Puerto Valor, famed for its swordsmen.
"Trained by his father Don Rodrigo from childhood, I thought he'd be a splendid knight.
"But one day, for reasons unknown, he had a huge fight with Don Rodrigo and left town.
"He was never heard from again...
"Just as well. I wanted to see Don Rodrigo too.
"Puerto Valor is a town with a big bridge on the east Costa Valor coast of the Medalliance region. {var:1}, let's go."
